caveats: Steady timing excludes source upload and the device-to-device analysis copy, both completed before submission and recorded as setup.

schedulerWorkerMs covers the actual SubmitDevice worker: TensorRT RecognizeDevice, scheduler resident reference/color/ink (plus GPU fingerprint for media stamps and registration for paired input), PrepareLines and status publication. Corroboration requests are empty.
A metering decorator forwards every DeviceImage call to the real AnalysisPool image, adding a virtual hop and clock reads around WaitReady and PrepareResidentAnalysis.

Stream stage intervals include launch gaps and external GPU contention. streamIntervalGapMs is profiled wall time not covered by any stage interval (host waits, merges, launch latency): an upper bound for host-control savings, not a measured saving.

Receipts cover exact TensorRT State closure only. The scheduler worker's thread_local resident context, AnalysisPool storage, the resident retirement queue and TensorRT/CUDA vendor threads have separate lifetimes. Record the process exit code separately.
No display, FPS, sensor-to-photon, first validated glyph, admission or screen-reader latency is measured.
This process runs OCR without decoder or presenter work; other GPU clients on the machine are not controlled here.
Candidate counts and cross-pair agreement are not accuracy. Truth-file CER is reading-order-sensitive and candidate-only.
The recognizer is created directly: a fallback, preparing or capacity-reduced result fails the run instead of being timed. The production automatic CPU fallback is unchanged.
